While the text says 'Depends on T012', the physical ordering places the consumer (test) before the producer (implementation) in the same phase block, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' artifact flow principle for independent testability. T010 should be moved to the 'Tests for User Story 1' block which is correctly placed after T012-T020, or T012 must be moved before T010.
